entries.content: Macros are people who have grown to giant sizes, with the smallest being 15 feet plus which are Mini Macros to miles tall with the biggest being 3 miles or giga Macros. In ancient times, those who grew in size were seen a blessed by the gods and were referred to as the chosen ones. They either destroyed and killed for their own pleasure or protected others and were kind. In the modern day they happily live with those smaller than them and help them out in many ways from heavy carrying to destroying buildings and land marked for destruction.

Micros are people who have shrunken in size from 1 foot tall, with the smallest ever recorded being a centimeter. In ancient times it was though that people who shrunken in size were cursed by the gods. In modern times, the world has made things more accessible for people who shrunk down by making railing on wall for them to walk through or latters and stairs for them to get to high places. Though small Micros can be useful, in ancient times they hid around people's houses and were the inspiration for legends such as the borrowers, Fairies, Brownies, Gnomes, Goblins, Leprechauns, and Pixies. In modern times, they are able to get into small spaces and even work with intricate machinery or items and work on them faster and more precise than a normal size person.

Randomly, without sign or warning, people will either shrink down in size or grow in size. No one knows how this happens and why certain people are effected by this phenomenon. That was until the modern day when scientists discover what activates it, in a low percentage of people a certain activator cell suddenly binds with their bodies making them grow or shrink depending. The cell can't be reproduced or even be properly genomed, it's unknown where this cell comes from or why it activates this phenomenon. In ancient times when there were no science or anything in the like, the people though it was magic and the gods either bless people by growing the or curse them by shrinking them.

The view of giants quite mixed in the world, depending on who you are they are either saints or devils. In ancient times, those who grew in size were sometimes an evil person who used their newfound powers to destroy and steal whatever. But there were others that used their powers for good and even fought evil giants, in the middle were those who became giants and continued their regular lives. In modern times, they live among others peacefully, even so crime and accidents can happen. They are giants that steal and destroy for self gain, usually taken down by giant police officers, while giants may fall into buildings or crush cars under their feel on accident. With this, many affected by giant's destruction my see them as liabilities and others who see giants help out see them as helpful and kind.

Given how small Micros are, many see them as weak and small in many ways. Some see them as unhelpful, prone to liabilities and are just cannon fodder, while some say they are weak and need to be protected. Despite this, many Micros have shone they can do well by themselves, such as being more precise and faster with crafting items like small clock work and circuitry compared to normal-sized people or even getting into small spaces. Micros tend to be looking down on, but they show their worth, even so those who see them as something to be protected tend to baby them much to Micros displeasure.

Since the dawn of time, the Macros and Micros have existed for unknown reasons. Macros spawned the legends of giants and titans, while micros started the legends of borrowers and fairies. The Macros were either unruly monsters or giant protectors, Micros his in the shadows trying to survive. To the people in ancient times, they thought this was the work of their gods blessing people into giant and curing those into tiny people. About 1500-1550 or so it suddenly stopped and in the modern age about 1970–1980 people were suddenly shrinking and growing again. Eventually, it was finally discovered why this was happening in the people who grew or shrunk was a special type of activator cell in their bodies which activates the sudden growth or shrinking. The cell is quite weak and is either destroyed in most peoples bodies or binds to the cells, spreading rapidly and mutating the host's body though viral evolution. In this case, it makes people grow or shrink, in the world there are 8 billion or so people with the cell only able to affect 0.1 of the population in this case 8 million around the world either grow or shrink while everyone else is unaffected. To accommodate the people, the world added many qualities to life for giants and tinies such as giants have wider streets to walk through and homes to accommodate the size, tinies have small homes to live in with railing and stairs to climb spaces that would be too tall for them.

In the past giants could do almost if not absolutely anything as there was no force but other giants to stop them, in the modern day this is different. With giants being a part of police and military and even the creation of anti-giant weaponry, no giant is free from the law. The giants laws are mostly the same as normal-sized laws with a few exceptions, due to their size they may accidentally cause destruction and this is a light infraction, intention a misdemeanor as long as no one was hurt, death on the other hand is immediate death row.

With the random chance of someone shrinking or growing, there was the creation of a service to help those who suddenly find themselves changing sizes. This service is called M.A.S.H, Macro And Smaller Helpers, a military/federal unit that acts as guides for those that suddenly change in size. If someone grows to giant heights such as 20 feet and above, other giants and units will quickly run to the scene and guide them to the nearest M.A.S.H center to help them get used to their new size.
